  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., -0.25 or -0.50) to account for market pessimism.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% downward correction in the next 3-5 days.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 5-day average, reduce by 5-8% in next 3-7 days.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or positive (e.g., 0.00), especially if prices have been trending downward.",
    "For horizon >15 days, reduce forecast volatility by smoothing out extreme outliers (e.g., >20% deviation from 10-day moving average).",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (e.g., >5 consecutive days), apply a downward bias correction of 3-5% per day until trend reverses.",
    "When sentiment history includes a 0.33 or higher positive signal, increase forecast sensitivity to recent highs, but cap at +10% above 10-day average to avoid overcorrection."
  ]
}
